# apipbx_conference (Resource)

A conference room. Import with "<tenant id>/<id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `number` (String) Dialable; shares the number space with extensions, ring groups and queues.
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Optional

- `admin_pin` (String, Sensitive) Entering it makes a caller an admin (can lock the room and kick the last caller); must differ from pin.
- `max_members` (Number) 0 is no limit.
- `mute_on_join` (Boolean)
- `pin` (String, Sensitive) Callers must enter it (up to 10 digits); empty leaves the room open.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
